company.what_they_do: MODELAB is an integrated fashion brand-building studio. It positions itself as a full-service creative team that takes a client's fashion idea from concept to launch-ready brand. Services span six core areas: (1) fashion design — collection development, silhouettes, trend research, materials; (2) brand strategy — positioning, audience definition, business concept, storytelling; (3) brand identity — naming, logos, typography, packaging, guidelines; (4) content and campaigns — photography, styling, video, art direction; (5) marketing — content strategy, influencer marketing, digital campaigns, community building; (6) production — sourcing, tech packs, manufacturing coordination, launch prep. The value proposition is 'everything under one roof' for clients who have a vision but lack an experienced fashion team.
